partners.mechanism_chain: CLCN1 (HGNC:2343) —DISRUPTS→ Myotonia Congenita (MONDO:0009715); ANO1 (HGNC:15443) —DISRUPTS→ Calcium Signaling (GO:0005509); Calcium Signaling (GO:0005509) —LEADS_TO→ Moyamoya Disease 7 (MONDO:0958202); Calcium Signaling (GO:0005509) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal vascular smooth muscle cell function (HP:0004934); CLCN1 (HGNC:2343) —BINDS→ Calcium Signaling (GO:0005509); ANO1 (HGNC:15443) —BINDS→ Calcium Signaling (GO:0005509).
